title: Checkpoint (schema v1)
description: One line of checkpoints/checkpoints.jsonl — a dated freeze of the log tip, anchored outside the repository (tools/checkpoint.py). The tip hash commits to the entire history before it, so one anchored checkpoint proves the first log_events events are byte-for-byte what was published. Carries fingerprints only, never words.

log_events.description: Length of the log when frozen; the tip is event log_events - 1.

log_tip_hash.description: The hash field of the newest event at freeze time. Also written to checkpoints/<date>-<tip12>.tip as a stable target for external anchors.

anchors.description: Where this checkpoint is witnessed outside the operator's hands. Anchors only add witnesses; losing one can never harm the archive.

kind.description: git: the commit and push of this file, dated by the host and replicated in every clone. opentimestamps: a Bitcoin-attested proof (see proof). public: any other dated, independent venue.

proof.description: For opentimestamps: filename of the .ots proof beside the .tip file (verify with `ots verify`).

note.description: For public anchors: where the tip hash was published.
